# GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Regenerate with tools/gen_runtime.py
# Simulation-only deduplication. Explicit sex/pregnancy-attempt hooks never
# consult this state and can count additional real encounters the same day.
# Variable lists are character-owned and survive save/reload. Reset each side
# only on a changed month, including when first reached through another faith.
sxad_prepare_natural_month_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = sxad_natural_month }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:sxad_natural_month = sxad_natural_month_value } }
            clear_variable_list = sxad_natural_partners
            set_variable = { name = sxad_natural_month value = sxad_natural_month_value }
        }
    }
    else = {
        clear_variable_list = sxad_natural_partners
        set_variable = { name = sxad_natural_month value = sxad_natural_month_value }
    }
}

# Current scope is one formal partner; PARTNER is the other character.
# Sex is independent of pregnancy, fertility, gender and pregnancy success.
# Mark BOTH directions before recording. A later callback from the spouse's
# faith, or a repeated consort link, therefore cannot count this pair again.
sxad_simulate_natural_pair_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes
            age >= 18
            exists = $PARTNER$
            $PARTNER$ = { is_alive = yes age >= 18 }
            NOT = { this = $PARTNER$ }
        }
        sxad_prepare_natural_month_effect = yes
        $PARTNER$ = { sxad_prepare_natural_month_effect = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = sxad_natural_partners
                        target = $PARTNER$
                    }
                }
            }
            save_temporary_scope_as = sxad_natural_first
            add_to_variable_list = { name = sxad_natural_partners target = $PARTNER$ }
            $PARTNER$ = {
                add_to_variable_list = { name = sxad_natural_partners target = scope:sxad_natural_first }
            }
            sxad_record_pair_effect = { PARTNER = $PARTNER$ }
        }
    }
}

# every_consort is used by stock romance/lover/culture effects. The explicit
# concubinist branch also covers the reverse concubine link; monthly pair
# deduplication makes it harmless if every_consort already returned that link.
# No sex/gender ordering is used, including for same-sex marriages or female
# rulers with male concubines. Infertile/pregnant adults are still eligible.
sxad_simulate_natural_character_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_alive = yes age >= 18 }
        save_temporary_scope_as = sxad_natural_owner
        every_consort = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes age >= 18 }
            save_temporary_scope_as = sxad_natural_partner
            scope:sxad_natural_owner = {
                sxad_simulate_natural_pair_effect = { PARTNER = scope:sxad_natural_partner }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_concubine = yes }
            this.concubinist = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = sxad_natural_partner
                scope:sxad_natural_owner = {
                    sxad_simulate_natural_pair_effect = { PARTNER = scope:sxad_natural_partner }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
